question: In the morning, a factory had 164 units. They multiplied their output by 4. They received 44 units from a supplier. They received 15 more units. The work took 60 minutes, or one hour. In the afternoon, they lost 575 units due to a mistake. By evening, they produced 7 more units. Their total was multiplied by 7 for export. How many units do they have?

A bakery started with 41 cookies. They baked 61 more. They sold 66 cookies. They divided the remaining into 4 equal groups and kept one group. It took 90 minutes, which is an hour and a half. They lost 5 cookies to damage. They multiplied their supply by 7 for a bulk order. They sold 26 cookies. How many cookies do they have?

In the morning, a painter had 197 dollars. By afternoon, she spent 28 dollars on supplies. She spent 78 more dollars. She tripled her remaining investment earnings. She worked 180 minutes, which is 3 hours. She then spent 290 dollars on equipment. How much money does she have?

A warehouse had 209 items. They lost 160 items in a shipment error. They received 33 replacement items. They returned 71 defective items. They had a dozen supervisors. They removed 7 more items for quality control. How many items do they have now?

A library had 200 books. They lost 145 books to damage. They lost 37 more to theft. They received 72 donated books. They had a dozen volunteers helping. They acquired 22 more books. How many books do they have?

A farm started with 51 animals. They multiplied their herd by 5 through breeding. They added 33 more animals from a purchase. The work took 120 minutes, or 2 hours. They divided their herd equally by 2 for two different pastures and took one pasture. They added 74 more animals. How many animals do they have?

A business had 231 dollars. They doubled their capital overnight. They spent 149 dollars on supplies. They doubled again with new profits. They spent 222 dollars. They divided by 2 to split the remaining capital. How much does each person get?

A small company had 215 dollars. They earned 62 dollars from sales. They earned 65 more dollars. They earned 25 more dollars. They doubled their earnings. They multiplied by 4 for reinvestment. They worked 240 minutes, which is 4 hours. They divided by 4 for equal distribution. How much per person?

A business had 190 items. They doubled their stock. They added 73 items. They removed 22 defective items. They multiplied by 6 through expansion. Their friend had 400 items. They multiplied by 9 more. How many items do they have?

A store had 157 items. They sold 18 items. They multiplied their remaining stock by 4. They divided by 2 equally. There were a dozen unsold items from the previous week. They multiplied by 6. How many items do they have?

In the morning, a plant had 193 items. They multiplied production by 8. They added 73 items. They added 66 more. They multiplied by 8 for export orders. They worked 180 minutes, which is 3 hours. They divided by 3 for three different shipments. By evening, how many items per shipment?

A workshop started with 141 items. They added 11 items. They multiplied by 9. Their partner had 300 items. They multiplied by 8. They divided by 2 equally. They doubled it again for two locations. How many per location?

A business had 141 items. They lost 117 items. They gained 17 items. They gained 47 more. They multiplied by 8. They had 9 locations needing stock. They sold 135 items. They gained 22 items. How many do they have?

A workshop started with 109 items. They tripled their stock. They spent 5 items for tools. They used 197 items in production. They used 86 more items. Their partner had 200 items. They multiplied by 8. How many items do they have?
A shop had 170 items. They added 60 items. They added 8 more. They removed 123 for quality. They added 64 more. How many items do they have now?
A warehouse had 239 items. They added 68. They removed 27. They removed 54 more. They had a dozen extra units. They removed 111. How many items remain?

In the morning, a factory had 230 items. They multiplied by 9. They multiplied by 6. They multiplied by 4. There was 13 bonus items. They worked 480 minutes, which is 8 hours. There was a loss of 6154 items. They added 68 in the evening. How many by the end of the day?
A store had 102 items. They removed 23. They removed 20 more. They multiplied by 6. Their partner had 300 items. They removed 77. They worked 60 minutes, or 1 hour. How many items?

A library had 204 books. They removed 192 due to damage. They divided the rest into 4 equal groups and kept one. They added 38 books. They added 25 more. Their sister library had 100 books. They removed 43. How many books do they have?

A business had 170 items. They multiplied by 7. They spent 575 dollars on supplies. They multiplied by 4. They divided by 6 into sections. There was a distractor item. They multiplied by 5. How many items?
A factory had 175 items. They multiplied by 4. They multiplied by 5. There was a loss of 2881 items. They multiplied by 3. The work took 180 minutes, which is 3 hours. How many items remain?
A workshop started with 49 items. They multiplied by 8. They added 36. They removed 78. There was a dozen tools available. They added 5. They removed 43. How many items?
A store had 208 items. They multiplied by 8. There was a loss of 1326 items. They lost 241 more. They had a distractor count of 75 items. They added 31. How many remain?
In the morning, a shop had 23 items. They doubled. They spent 29 items. They added 29. By afternoon, they divided by 2. By evening, how many items?
A warehouse had 178 items. Their partner had 150 items. They added 49. They added 78. They added 58. They multiplied by 6. How many items?
